card.name: Adjectives before area/use/indication nouns
card.fires_on: Descriptive adjectives such as priority, approved, contemporary or psychiatric that come right after a number, quantifier or 'other' and before a noun like areas, uses, indication or disorders.

modes.label: approved uses
modes.description: The word approved (often after un-) before uses or indication in drug label text.
modes.example: Potential serious adverse reactions after BOTOX injections for un<<approved>> uses ( 5.3 )

modes.label: adjective after a count or 'other'
modes.description: An adjective following 'one of the seven', 'a number of' or 'other' in general prose.
modes.example: identified oceans (or the "blue economy") as one of the seven<< priority>> areas for sustainable development.

card.writes: It adds words about favorites, passions and counted items, such as favorite, passions and 几个.
card.plain: It marks an adjective sitting in a list-like phrase such as 'other psychiatric disorders' or 'approved indication'.
